inputs.IN_JUSTIFICATION: Fabrication baseline A/2 re-issue, PCB revision A unchanged (PCB source unchanged). Fabrication drawing rev A, first lettered issue, supersedes the drawing issued with 0.1.3 (revision identifier 0.1.3); it corrects the minimum-feature table to the design rules: trace to trace 0.200 mm (0.1.3 drawing 0.600), min PTH hole 0.300 mm (0.600), annular ring 0.150 mm (0.200). Gerber F.Silkscreen now includes the TP1 GND and TP2 +3V3 labels; the 0.1.3 Gerbers omitted them (plot_footprint_values off) while the 0.1.3 ODB++ contained them. Assembly drawing rev A, first lettered issue, content unchanged. Schematic rev B: revision variables. Title-block logo and project name restored. Fabrication requirements declared unchanged from 0.1.3.
